description: Parses a User-Agent string: browser and version, rendering engine, operating system and version, device type, vendor and model, CPU, and whether it is a known crawler (Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, AhrefsBot and a few more) with its name. Optional Client Hints values (platform, mobile, model) are reported as given. Parsed with ua-parser-js 1.x (MIT). Pure code, no outside request. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

chModel.description: Client Hints model, up to 60 characters (optional)

ua.description: The User-Agent string, up to 1000 characters
